prompt.en: Based on this architecture doc, generate a product architecture diagram, an on-premises deployment network topology diagram, and a backup and recovery architecture diagram.
prompt.zh: 基于这份架构文档，帮我生成一张产品架构图、一张本地化部署网络拓扑图，以及一张备份与恢复架构图。

reply.en: Generated all three diagrams from the architecture doc: a layered product architecture diagram (interaction, execution, capability, models/tools, task management, and deployment layers), an on-premises network topology diagram (DMZ, application, and data zones with traffic flows), and a backup & recovery architecture diagram covering scheduled backups and access controls.
reply.zh: 已根据架构文档生成全部三张图：分层的产品架构图（交互层、执行控制层、能力集成层、模型与工具层、任务管理层、服务部署层），本地化部署网络拓扑图（DMZ、应用、数据分区及流量走向），以及备份与恢复架构图（定期备份策略与访问控制）。

caption.zh: 本地化部署网络拓扑图
